note: Published IsaacLab Spot locomotion weights, verbatim, plus one added term (duty_floor). The 14 Spot weights are inherited from v8 and are not edited.

duty_floor.rationale: Spot's GaitReward constrains only relative foot timing; a 84/16 duty split satisfies all six of its pairwise comparisons exactly as well as 50/50. air_time_reward scores max(air, contact), rewarding both extremes. Nothing in the 14-term table pins the duty factor, so v8 converged to a two-legged drag. This term is the missing floor.
